sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她仅被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: June 29, 2003, in the United Kingdom town of Uldringham, patrons were enjoying a beer in a corner pub affectionately known as the Fishbowl,
sentences.zh: 2003年6月29日，在英国奥尔德林厄姆（Uldringham）镇，常客们正坐在一家被亲切地称为“鱼缸”（Fishbowl）的街角酒吧里喝着啤酒，

sentences.en: due to its large floor-to-ceiling glass walls.
sentences.zh: 这得名于它那巨大的落地玻璃墙。

sentences.en: It was a stifling hot day by English standards, even for the height of summer,
sentences.zh: 按英国的标准来看，即使在盛夏时节，那天也闷热得令人窒息，

sentences.en: and the Fishbowl was the perfect place to escape into air-conditioned comfort and refresh with a cold drink.
sentences.zh: 而“鱼缸”酒吧是逃进空调房、喝杯冷饮消暑的绝佳去处。

sentences.en: The Fishbowl was situated in Goose Green, an enclave nestled in a quiet, yet fashionable part of Uldringham, a market town in Greater Manchester.
sentences.zh: “鱼缸”酒吧位于鹅绿（Goose Green），这是一个坐落在奥尔德林厄姆宁静而时尚地段的飞地，该镇是大曼彻斯特地区的一个集镇。

sentences.en: The town featured the red-brick buildings typical of Manchester, filled with independent and artisan businesses, including a deli, a butcher, and a cafe.
sentences.zh: 镇上有着曼彻斯特典型的红砖建筑，遍布着各类独立经营的手工艺店铺，包括熟食店、肉铺和咖啡馆。

sentences.en: It was frequented by shoppers wanting to get away from the more sterile, commercialised environment of nearby Trafford Centre Shopping Mall.
sentences.zh: 这里常有购物者光顾，他们想逃离附近特拉福德中心购物广场那种冷冰冰的商业化环境。

sentences.en: A brick-paved pedestrian square featured a sculpture of a flock of geese at its centre, surrounded by benches where local workers gathered and enjoyed their lunch in the sunshine.
sentences.zh: 砖铺的步行广场中央有一座鹅群雕塑，周围环绕着长椅，当地工人们常聚在那里，在阳光下享用午餐。

sentences.en: Aside from the odd shoplifter, crime and drama were not something the regulars at Goose Green were accustomed to.
sentences.zh: 除了偶尔出现的商店扒手，鹅绿的常客们对犯罪和戏剧性的事件并不熟悉。

sentences.en: So, when an ambulance and police cars came roaring into the area with their sirens blaring and pulled up at an alleyway entrance 30 metres away from the Fishbowl pub,
sentences.zh: 因此，当救护车和警车鸣着警笛呼啸而至，停在距离“鱼缸”酒吧30米远的一条小巷入口时，

sentences.en: onlookers were curious.
sentences.zh: 围观者们都感到十分好奇。

sentences.en: First responders rushed into the alley after receiving reports of a stabbing.
sentences.zh: 急救人员在接到刺伤报告后冲进了小巷。

sentences.en: Towards the dead end of the narrow passageway, they found a teenage boy lying in a pool of blood and on the brink of death.
sentences.zh: 在狭窄通道的尽头，他们发现一名十几岁的男孩倒在血泊中，生命垂危。

sentences.en: Paramedics went to work, fighting to keep him alive as his organs began to fail.
sentences.zh: 医护人员立即展开抢救，在他器官开始衰竭时竭力维持他的生命。

sentences.en: He had suffered two severe stab wounds, the first to his chest and the second deep into his abdomen.
sentences.zh: 他身中两处重伤，一处在胸部，另一处深及腹部。

sentences.en: A large kitchen knife lay on the ground beside his body.
sentences.zh: 一把大号厨房用刀掉在他身旁的地上。

sentences.en: The victim was rushed to Manchester's Withenshaw Hospital with life-threatening injuries.
sentences.zh: 受害者被紧急送往曼彻斯特的威森肖医院（Withenshaw Hospital），伤势危及生命。

sentences.en: Blood pooled inside his stomach cavity, restricting the function of his lungs and diaphragm.
sentences.zh: 血液积聚在他的腹腔内，压迫着肺部和横膈膜的功能。

sentences.en: Whilst on the operating table, the patient's heart stopped twice as surgeons removed his gallbladder and fought desperately to stabilise him.
sentences.zh: 在手术台上，病人的心脏曾两次停止跳动，外科医生在切除其胆囊并拼命试图稳定他生命体征的同时，将他从鬼门关拉了回来。

sentences.en: The teenager emerged from the operation in a critical condition and was taken to the intensive care unit where a respirator was used to assist his breathing.
sentences.zh: 这名少年在手术后处于危急状态，被送往重症监护室，并使用呼吸机辅助呼吸。

sentences.en: The attack in the alley was witnessed by the victim's teenage friend,
sentences.zh: 小巷里的袭击事件被受害者的一位少年朋友目击，

sentences.en: who told police the pair had been walking through Goose Green sipping on soft drinks they had bought from a nearby McDonald's
sentences.zh: 他告诉警方，两人当时正喝着从附近麦当劳买的软饮，走在鹅绿，

sentences.en: when they were accosted by a man aged in his twenties, wearing a black hoodie, black jeans and white baseball cap.
sentences.zh: 这时一名二十出头的男子拦住了他们，该男子身穿黑色连帽衫、黑色牛仔裤，戴着白色棒球帽。

sentences.en: The unknown man had tried to grab one of the teenagers and dragged them into the alley.
sentences.zh: 这名陌生男子试图抓住其中一名少年，并将他们拖进小巷。

sentences.en: In the ensuing scuffle, the assailant pulled out a knife and stabbed the victim twice before fleeing the scene.
sentences.zh: 在随后的扭打中，袭击者掏出一把刀，刺伤受害者两刀后逃离现场。

sentences.en: Following the attack, Greater Manchester Police put out a public appeal to identify the suspect.
sentences.zh: 袭击发生后，大曼彻斯特警方发布了公开呼吁，请求民众协助确认嫌疑人身份。

sentences.en: Newspapers were soon reporting alleged sightings of the perpetrator,
sentences.zh: 报纸很快报道了据称目击到肇事者的消息，

sentences.en: with the Manchester Evening News announcing someone who fit the description was later seen at Altrincham's Metrolink station.
sentences.zh: 《曼彻斯特晚报》宣称，有人在奥尔特灵厄姆（Altrincham）的轻轨车站看到了符合描述的人。

sentences.en: With no clue to suggest a motive, police worked swiftly, concerned the unknown assailant may strike again.
sentences.zh: 由于没有任何动机线索，警方迅速展开行动，担心这名身份不明的袭击者可能会再次作案。

sentences.en: Investigators retrieved footage from the few CCTV cameras in the Goose Green area and discovered they were in luck.
sentences.zh: 调查人员调取了鹅绿地区为数不多的闭路电视监控录像，发现他们运气不错。

sentences.en: One camera faced directly towards the alleyway where the teenager was attacked.
sentences.zh: 其中一个摄像头正对着少年遇袭的小巷。

sentences.en: In the early 2000s, the internet had become more affordable and available in homes throughout the United Kingdom, and as a result, online chat rooms soared in popularity.
sentences.zh: 21世纪初，互联网在英国各地的家庭中变得更加普及且负担得起，因此，在线聊天室的受欢迎程度飙升。

sentences.en: Chat rooms were not completely new.
sentences.zh: 聊天室并非什么新鲜事物。

sentences.en: They had been around in some form since the late 1980s, and had spawned an entire language of their own.
sentences.zh: 它们自20世纪80年代末就以某种形式存在，并衍生出了一套属于自己的语言。

sentences.en: Online conversations typically started with the ubiquitous greeting,
sentences.zh: 在线对话通常以无处不在的问候语开始，

sentences.en: Hi, ASL, which stood for Age, Sex, Location.
sentences.zh: “Hi, ASL”，即年龄（Age）、性别（Sex）、地点（Location）的缩写。

sentences.en: The response would generally determine whether communications between participants would continue.
sentences.zh: 对方的回答通常决定了参与者之间的交流是否会继续下去。

sentences.en: In the days before Gmail, Facebook, WhatsApp, Snapchat, Twitter, and Instagram, teenagers were turning in droves to MSN Chat,
sentences.zh: 在Gmail、Facebook、WhatsApp、Snapchat、Twitter和Instagram出现之前的日子里，青少年们纷纷涌向MSN聊天室，

sentences.en: one of the first computer services to allow online users to communicate directly from their web browser with little to no technical knowledge.
sentences.zh: 这是最早允许在线用户直接从网页浏览器进行交流，且几乎不需要任何技术知识的计算机服务之一。

sentences.en: Users simply logged in under nicknames and were instantly able to create or join hundreds of chat rooms reflecting every sort of hobby, interest, and demographic imaginable.
sentences.zh: 用户只需用昵称登录，就能立即创建或加入数百个反映各种爱好、兴趣和人群的聊天室。

sentences.en: Popular rooms were a never-ending flow of scrolling text recorded in real time,
sentences.zh: 热门聊天室里滚动着实时记录的文字流，永无止境，

sentences.en: as users typed questions and comments to one another peppered with emoticons, abbreviations, acronyms, and changing text colours.
sentences.zh: 用户们互相输入问题和评论，其中夹杂着表情符号、缩写、首字母缩略词和不断变化的文字颜色。

sentences.en: Current active users within a room were listed in a box to the right of the screen, with alerts informing others whenever someone logged in or out.
sentences.zh: 房间内当前的活跃用户列表显示在屏幕右侧的方框中，每当有人登录或退出时，系统都会发出提醒。

sentences.en: Clicking on a username would allow you to initiate a private chat function with that person, known as whispers.
sentences.zh: 点击用户名即可与该人发起私聊功能，被称为“悄悄话”（whispers）。

sentences.en: Users didn't have to provide any identification and could log in under any screen name or profile they liked.
sentences.zh: 用户无需提供任何身份证明，可以使用任何喜欢的网名或个人资料登录。

sentences.en: This anonymity came with both pros and cons.
sentences.zh: 这种匿名性既有优点也有缺点。

sentences.en: People could adopt an alias, ensuring they were safe to interact online without fears of being identified in the real world.
sentences.zh: 人们可以采用化名，确保自己在网上互动时是安全的，不必担心在现实世界中被认出。

sentences.en: Yet, this meant users were not always who they said they were.
sentences.zh: 然而，这也意味着用户并不总是他们所声称的那样。

sentences.en: Online chat rooms were a hotbed for adult predators pretending to be much younger than they were in order to have sexually charged conversations with unsuspecting teens.
sentences.zh: 在线聊天室是成年掠夺者的温床，他们假装比实际年龄小得多，以便与毫无戒心的青少年进行充满性暗示的对话。

sentences.en: Mark was a typical 16-year-old from Stockport, one of the more sought-after postcodes in Manchester.
sentences.zh: 马克（Mark）是来自斯托克波特（Stockport）的一名典型的16岁少年，那里是曼彻斯特较受欢迎的邮编区之一。

sentences.en: Tall, fair-haired, and with a powerful build, Mark was the only child of working-class parents who provided him a good upbringing.
sentences.zh: 马克身材高大，皮肤白皙，体格健壮，是工薪阶层父母的独生子，他们给了他良好的教养。

sentences.en: His school grades were average and aspirations modest, hoping to do well enough at business college to find work.
sentences.zh: 他的学校成绩平平，志向也比较朴实，希望在商学院表现足够好，以便找到工作。

sentences.en: Although not academically inclined, Mark was still well-liked by his teachers, stayed out of trouble, and was passionate about sport, especially soccer.
sentences.zh: 虽然在学术上没有太大天赋，但马克仍然很受老师喜爱，从不惹麻烦，并且对运动充满热情，尤其是足球。

sentences.en: He was popular with the girls at school, but wasn't always sure how to interact with them.
sentences.zh: 他在学校里很受女生欢迎，但并不总是确定如何与她们互动。

sentences.en: In 2002, the computer Mark's parents had bought to help with his schoolwork opened up a whole new world to the teenager.
sentences.zh: 2002年，马克父母为帮助他学习而购买的电脑，为这名少年打开了一个全新的世界。

sentences.en: Once he connected to the internet, Mark was introduced to online chat rooms, where he could talk to strangers from all over the world from the safety of his bedroom.
sentences.zh: 一旦连上互联网，马克就被引入了在线聊天室，在那里他可以在卧室的安全环境中与来自世界各地的陌生人交谈。

sentences.en: The computer screen provided a barrier that allowed Mark to be more open and at ease than he was in his real-life interactions,
sentences.zh: 电脑屏幕提供了一道屏障，让马克比在现实生活中互动时更加开放和自在，

sentences.en: and he found himself spending most of his spare time online.
sentences.zh: 他发现自己把大部分业余时间都花在了网上。

sentences.en: In February 2003, Mark was logged in to one of his favourite online chat rooms for Manchester teenagers.
sentences.zh: 2003年2月，马克登录了他最喜欢的曼彻斯特青少年在线聊天室之一。

sentences.en: He was one of the millions of teenage boys who went online hoping to meet girls, and whenever a new person with a feminine username appeared in the chat room,
sentences.zh: 他是数百万上网希望结识女孩的少年之一，每当聊天室里出现一个带有女性化用户名的陌生人时，

sentences.en: Mark would strike up a conversation, hoping to turn successful online interactions into real-world hookups.
sentences.zh: 马克就会主动搭讪，希望能将成功的在线互动转化为现实中的约会。

sentences.en: Mark perked up when a new user logged in to the Manchester teens' chat room under the screen name Rachel underscore WeSt.
sentences.zh: 当一名新用户以“Rachel_WeSt”的网名登录曼彻斯特青少年聊天室时，马克精神为之一振。

sentences.en: After Rachel introduced herself to the room, Mark summoned the courage to initiate a private chat, discovering she was also a 16-year-old Manchester local.
sentences.zh: 在瑞秋（Rachel）向房间里的人自我介绍后，马克鼓起勇气发起私聊，发现她也是一位16岁的曼彻斯特本地人。

sentences.en: Rachel worked at a gymnasium, and her uploaded photograph showed a slim, fresh-faced teen girl with long blonde hair.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋在一家健身房工作，她上传的照片显示这是一个苗条、面容清秀的少女，留着一头金色长发。

sentences.en: Mark couldn't believe his luck that out of all the people in the chat room, Rachel seemed to want to speak to him the moSt.
sentences.zh: 马克简直不敢相信自己的运气，在聊天室里的所有人中，瑞秋似乎最想和他说话。

sentences.en: Their banter came easily, and Rachel seemed open to more provocative conversation.
sentences.zh: 他们的调侃进行得很轻松，瑞秋似乎对更具挑逗性的对话持开放态度。

sentences.en: Mark turned on his webcam so that she could see him, but Rachel wasn't keen on video chatting, alluding it was due to troubling online interactions she had in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 马克打开了摄像头让她看自己，但瑞秋对视频聊天并不热衷，暗示这是因为她过去在网上有过令人不安的互动经历。

sentences.en: For the next two days, Mark loitered in the Manchester teens' chat room awaiting the words,
sentences.zh: 接下来的两天里，马克在曼彻斯特青少年聊天室里徘徊，等待着屏幕上出现那行字：

sentences.en: Rachel West has entered the room, to appear on screen.
sentences.zh: “Rachel West已进入房间”。

sentences.en: Days after Mark and Rachel's first online encounter, another new person entered the Manchester teens' chat room,
sentences.zh: 在马克和瑞秋第一次在线相遇几天后，又有一个新人进入了曼彻斯特青少年聊天室，

sentences.en: 14-year-old John.
sentences.zh: 14岁的约翰（John）。

sentences.en: Rachel introduced the newcomer as her little brother, but John later clarified their relationship as stepbrother and stepsister.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋介绍这位新人是她的弟弟，但约翰后来澄清他们的关系是继兄妹。

sentences.en: The stepsiblings lived in a well-to-do neighbourhood in Manchester, in a comfortable double-storey brick house with a garden.
sentences.zh: 这对继兄妹住在曼彻斯特一个富裕的社区，住在一栋带花园的舒适双层砖房里。

sentences.en: The family were firmly middle-class, not rich by any means, but afflorn enough to send the children to private schools.
sentences.zh: 这个家庭属于坚定的中产阶级，绝非富有，但足以供孩子们上私立学校。

sentences.en: John's childhood was marred by instability and poor father figures.
sentences.zh: 约翰的童年因生活不稳定和缺乏良好的父亲形象而蒙上阴影。

sentences.en: His parents split when he was seven years old, and later, John stumbled across his birth certificate and discovered the man whom he grew up believing to be his father
sentences.zh: 他的父母在他七岁时分开了，后来，约翰偶然发现了自己的出生证明，发现他从小认为是他父亲的那个人，

sentences.en: was actually not at all.
sentences.zh: 其实根本不是。

sentences.en: It turned out John's biological father was a violent man whom had once tried to abduct him as a baby, leading his mother to flee the situation.
sentences.zh: 原来约翰的亲生父亲是一个暴力狂，曾在他还是婴儿时试图绑架他，导致他的母亲不得不逃离那种处境。

sentences.en: John's mother had a string of unsuccessful relationships over the years, before settling down with a plumber when John was 11 years old, who remained his stepfather ever since.
sentences.zh: 约翰的母亲多年来经历了一系列不成功的恋情，直到约翰11岁时与一名水管工安定下来，那人此后一直是他继父。

sentences.en: John was given a laptop to help with his studies and soon began frequenting internet chat rooms, meeting Mark online just a few weeks later.
sentences.zh: 约翰得到了一台笔记本电脑来辅助学习，很快就开始频繁出入互联网聊天室，几周后就在网上遇到了马克。

sentences.en: Their households both had broadband internet connections, quite a novelty at the time, which meant they could be online for hours
sentences.zh: 他们的家庭都有宽带互联网连接，这在当时相当新奇，这意味着他们可以在线数小时，

sentences.en: without tying up the phone line or running up massive bills.
sentences.zh: 而不会占用电话线或产生巨额账单。

sentences.en: Although there was a two-year age difference between them,
sentences.zh: 尽管他们之间有两岁的年龄差，

sentences.en: John and Mark shared mutual interests in gaming, girls and football, and quickly struck up an online friendship.
sentences.zh: 约翰和马克在游戏、女孩和足球方面有着共同的兴趣，很快就建立起了在线友谊。

sentences.en: They bonded over movies they both enjoyed, especially the crime drama Catch Me If You Can, a film based on the true story of a teenage prankster
sentences.zh: 他们因共同喜爱的电影而结缘，特别是犯罪剧情片《猫鼠游戏》（Catch Me If You Can），这部电影改编自一名少年恶作剧者的真实故事，

sentences.en: who grew up to become one of the world's most wanted con men.
sentences.zh: 他长大后成为了世界上最受通缉的诈骗犯之一。

sentences.en: The pair turned on their webcams during interactions, proving they were exactly who they claimed to be.
sentences.zh: 两人在互动时打开了摄像头，证明他们确实是他们所声称的那个人。

sentences.en: These webcam hangouts were spent gaming or searching internet forums together and made the two feel as though they were in the same room.
sentences.zh: 这些视频聊天时光通常用于一起玩游戏或浏览互联网论坛，让两人感觉就像身处同一个房间一样。

sentences.en: When it was just the two of them, conversations were dominated by X-rated topics typical of teenage boys.
sentences.zh: 当只有他们两人时，对话往往被少年们典型的成人话题所主导。

sentences.en: Although Mark liked the younger John and the pair soon became best friends, it was Rachel who Mark hoped to see whenever he logged in online.
sentences.zh: 虽然马克喜欢年纪较小的约翰，两人很快成了最好的朋友，但每当马克上网时，他最希望看到的还是瑞秋。
